```{r, evaluation_01, eval=TRUE}
# ================================
# 1. Data load
# ================================
# Baseline
#df <- read_csv("../../code/orb/test_keyframe_results_02_with_no.csv")
# SAM+GroundingDINO
df <- read_csv("../../code/orb/test_keyframe_results_sam_dino_masked_with_no.csv")
# ViT patch feature (DINOv2)
#df <- read_csv("../../code/orb/test_keyframe_results_dinov2_cached_w672_with_no.csv")

# test frame index extraction from the file row
df <- df %>%
  mutate(test_idx = row_number())

# ================================
# 2. Inlier Ratio distribution
# ================================
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = inlier_ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of Inlier Ratio") +
  xlab("Inlier Ratio") +
  ylab("Count")

print(p1)

# ================================
# 3. Inliers vs Matches
# ================================
p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = num_matches, y = num_inliers)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  ggtitle("Inliers vs Matches") +
  xlab("# Matches") +
  ylab("# Inliers")

print(p2)

# ================================
# 4. Success vs Failure
# ================================
p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = success, fill = success)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  ggtitle("Success vs Failure Count") +
  ylim(0, max(table(df$success)) * 1.1)

print(p3)

# ================================
# 5. Inlier Ratio vs Success
# ================================
p4 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = success, y = inlier_ratio, fill = success)) +
  # median
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 3)),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 5
  ) +
  # mean
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,        # diamond
    size = 3,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 3)),
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 5,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  ggtitle("Inlier Ratio by Success")

print(p4)

# ================================
# 5-1. Overall Inlier Ratio Boxplot
# ================================
p4_all <- ggplot(df, aes(x = "All", y = inlier_ratio)) +
  # median
  geom_boxplot(fill = "gray80") +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 3)),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 5
  ) +
  # mean
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 3,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 3)),
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 5,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  ggtitle("Overall Inlier Ratio") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("inlier_ratio")

print(p4_all)

# ================================
# 6. Inlier Ratio by Frame index
# ================================
p5 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = test_idx, y = inlier_ratio)) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Inlier Ratio over Time (Frame Index)") +
  xlab("Frame Index") +
  ylab("Inlier Ratio")

print(p5)

# ================================
# 8. Success rate
# ================================
success_rate <- mean(df$success)
print(paste("Success Rate:", round(success_rate * 100, 2), "%"))

# ================================
# 9. Result trend by "no"
# ================================
# This section uses the same df loaded above:
# df <- read_csv("../code/orb/test_keyframe_results_dinov2_cached_w672_with_no - temp.csv")
#
# Graph 1:
#   x-axis: no
#   y-axis: best_keyframe_list_idx
#
# Graph 2:
#   x-axis: no
#   left y-axis : num_matches, num_inliers, num_outlier
#   right y-axis: inlier_ratio

# Handle both possible spellings: num_outlier and num_outliers.
# The user's CSV uses num_outlier, but this makes the code robust.
if ("num_outlier" %in% names(df) && !("num_outliers" %in% names(df))) {
  df <- df %>%
    rename(num_outliers = num_outlier)
}

# ================================
# 9-1. Keyframe index change
# ================================
#p9_keyframe <- ggplot(df, aes(x = no, y = best_keyframe_list_idx)) +
#  #geom_line(linewidth = 0.1) +
#  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
#  ggtitle("Best Keyframe Index vs Test Image Number") +
#  xlab("no") +
#  ylab("best_keyframe_list_idx") +
#  theme_minimal()
#
#print(p9_keyframe)

# Calculate decrease point
df <- df %>%
  arrange(no) %>%
  mutate(
    keyframe_diff = best_keyframe_list_idx - lag(best_keyframe_list_idx),
    decrease_flag = keyframe_diff < 0
  )

# Decrease count
decrease_count <- sum(df$decrease_flag, na.rm = TRUE)

# Decrease ratio
total_steps <- sum(!is.na(df$keyframe_diff))
decrease_ratio <- decrease_count / total_steps

cat("Number of decreases in best_keyframe_list_idx:", decrease_count, "\n")
cat("Decrease ratio:", round(decrease_ratio, 3), "\n")

# Graph
p9_keyframe <- ggplot(df, aes(x = no, y = best_keyframe_list_idx)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +

  # Red
  geom_point(
    data = df %>% filter(decrease_flag == TRUE),
    aes(x = no, y = best_keyframe_list_idx),
    color = "red",
    size = 0.1
  ) +

  ggtitle("Best Keyframe Index vs Test Image Number") +
  xlab("no") +
  ylab("best_keyframe_list_idx") +
  theme_minimal()

print(p9_keyframe)

# ================================
# 9-2. Matching metrics + inlier ratio
#      Left axis : counts
#      Right axis: inlier_ratio
# ================================
count_cols <- c("num_matches", "num_inliers", "num_outliers")

# Scale inlier_ratio so it can be drawn on the same plot as count metrics.
# The secondary y-axis converts the scaled value back to the original inlier_ratio scale.
count_max <- max(unlist(df[count_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
ratio_max <- max(df$inlier_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

# Avoid division by zero if ratio_max is 0 or missing.
if (is.na(ratio_max) || ratio_max == 0) {
  ratio_scale_factor <- 1
} else {
  ratio_scale_factor <- count_max / ratio_max
}

counts_long <- df %>%
  select(no, all_of(count_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(count_cols),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

p9_metrics <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = counts_long,
    aes(x = no, y = value, color = metric),
    linewidth = 0.05
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = counts_long,
    aes(x = no, y = value, color = metric),
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df,
    aes(x = no, y = inlier_ratio * ratio_scale_factor, color = "inlier_ratio"),
    linewidth = 0.05,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df,
    aes(x = no, y = inlier_ratio * ratio_scale_factor, color = "inlier_ratio"),
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Counts (num_matches / num_inliers / num_outliers)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ . / ratio_scale_factor,
      name = "inlier_ratio"
    )
  ) +
  ggtitle("Matching Metrics and Inlier Ratio vs Test Image Number") +
  xlab("no") +
  labs(color = "Metric") +
  theme_minimal()

print(p9_metrics)

```
